resolution_criteria: YES if the Republican Party's nominee wins the 2028 US presidential election by winning a majority of electoral votes (or, failing an Electoral College majority, is chosen president through the contingent election). NO if a candidate of any other party or an independent wins. Decided by the Associated Press's call. If AP has not called it within 60 days of election day, the certified official result decides.
